name: Dranik Catacombs: Halls
summary: The deepest halls of the Dranik Catacombs, where Discord corruption is strongest.
description: The Halls represent the deepest and most corrupted part of the Dranik Catacombs. Once sacred Dragorn ceremonial chambers, they have been overtaken by Muramite inquisitors and warped by Discord energy. The stone walls pulse with arcane corruption, undead Dragorn guardians roam the corridors, and Discord anomalies tear open unstable pockets of reality. Muramite high inquisitors oversee brutal experiments and rituals in the deepest sanctum.
